questions.question:
If A denotes '+', B denotes '×', C denotes '−', and D denotes '÷', then what will be the value of the following expression?

10 B 19 A 10 D 10 C 7 = ?
questions.solution:
**Explanation:**

Decoding the information, 

 
 

 
 
Letter

 
 
 
A

 
 
 
B

 
 
 
C

 
 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
Means

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

Given:

10 B 19 A 10 D 10 C 7 =?

After replacing the signs from left to right and using the BODMAS rule,

= 10 × 19 + __**10 ÷ 10**__ - 7

= __**10 × 19**__ + 1 - 7

= __**190 + 1**__ - 7

= __191__*__ – __*__7__

= 184

Hence, “184” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

54 * 6 * 72 * 8 * 3 * 15
questions.solution:
Explanation:

BODMAS RULE:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/337cba09b098a129c60c88ca431dc00f7470bb1b39c1452e8d81688a7d6b6b0e.png] 

Let's check each option:

Option 1. ÷, +, ÷, −, =

Given equation: 54 * 6 * 72 * 8 * 3 * 15

After replacing the signs, we get:

⇒ __**54 ÷ 6**__ + __**72 ÷ 8**__ - 3 = 15

⇒ **__9__**__** + **9__ - 3 = 15

⇒ 18 - 3 = 15

**⇒ 15 = 15**

Option 2 .÷, −, −, +, =

Given equation: 54 * 6 * 72 * 8 * 3 * 15

After replacing the signs, we get:

⇒ __54 ÷ 6__ - 72 - 8 + 3 = 15

⇒ 9 - 72 - 8 + 3 = 15

⇒ -68 ≠ 15

Option 3. +, ÷, ×, +, =

Given equation: 54 * 6 * 72 * 8 * 3 * 15

After replacing the signs, we get:

⇒ 54 + __**6 ÷ 72**__ × 8 + 3 = 15

⇒ 54 + __0.083** × 8**__ + 3 = 15

⇒ __**54 + 0.67 + 3**__ = 15

⇒ 57.67 ≠ 15

Option 4. ×, −, −, +, =

Given equation: 54 * 6 * 72 * 8 * 3 * 15

After replacing the signs, we get:

⇒ __**54 × 6**__ - 72 - 8 + 3 = 15

⇒ 324 - 72 - 8 + 3 = 15

⇒ 247 ≠ 15

Hence," ÷, +, ÷, −, =" is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 30 April 1983 was a Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 13 August 1989?
questions.solution:
Given that:-

 
• **No of days from 1 May 1983 to 13 August 1989**-

 
 
• Days in year 1983 after 30 April 1983 = (365 - 31 - 28 - 31 - 30) = 245
 
• Days in year 1984, 1988 = 366 + 366 (leap year) = 732
 
• Days in year 1985, 1986, 1987 = 365 + 365 + 365 = 1095 
 
• Days in year 1989 upto 13 August = (31 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 13) = 225
 
• **Total no. of days** = 245 + 732 + 1095 + 225 = **2297**
 
 
 
• Since, it was Saturday on 30 April 1983, every 7th day from 30 April will be a Saturday.
 
• Thus, **no. of odd days** = 2297/7 =** 1**
 
• Now, 30 April 1983 (Saturday) + 1 odd day = 13 August 1989 (Sunday)
 
• 13 August 1989 will be **Sunday**.

Hence, "option 2" is the correct answer.
